evidence.name: Screen field: Space inside the picker
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space inside the picker" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space inside the picker
sections.description: Sets the empty space, in pixels, inside the picker container on each side: top, right, bottom, left, between the border and the spinning wheels. The default is usually a small value; increase it to give the wheels breathing room, or keep it tight for a compact picker. A clean, uncluttered picker feels effortless to use, which helps visitors commit their answer and continue through the funnel.
